headline: State Financial Supervision Service launches unscheduled inspection of the State Lottery Company
summary: Kyrgyzstan's State Financial Supervision Service has started an unscheduled inspection of the State Lottery Company. The agency published the announcement on its website.
why: State-owned lottery operators handle public gaming revenue, and regulatory audits can affect their governance and financial reporting. Financial supervision bodies oversee compliance of such entities.
original_headline: Госфиннадзор начал внеплановую проверку Государственной лотерейной компании
